notes.title: Gears of Dragoon is Now Available
notes.content:
The wait is officially over—Gears of Dragoon: Fragments of a New Era is live! Trust us, this game is the epic tale you didn't know you were waiting for. Mega thanks to those who stuck with us during the delays. We're extremely grateful for your patience as we added some finishing touches to the game.

Ready for the dungeon crawling adventure? You'll be stepping into the dusty boots of Rustar, a young adventurer juggling magical prowess with mechanical know-how. What's he up to? Just poking his nose into Dragonschaft, a labyrinth brimming with such an absurd mix of magic and machinery. And let's not gloss over the squad—so many memorable waifus!

So dive in and test your mettle! You've been patient, and we swear it’s gonna pay off.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999870/

notes.title: Gears of Dragoon Releasing October 23rd
notes.content:
We offer our sincerest regrets as we delay Gears of Dragoon yet again, until Monday, October 23rd. We know that this isn't what you want to hear, and ask for your patience.

The game is long, with a complex story that spans an immense amount of text; it leaves a lot of room for polishing, and we want to provide only the best experience possible. And that extends beyond the story; we're working to make the UI even better than the original release, and want it to be an immensely enjoyable experience on all fronts.

So thank you! For your patience, and your understanding. We appreciate all fans of Ninetail who have stuck with us, and whom are also excited for this release. We won't keep you waiting much longer at all!
